articles.summary: MPT (the “Company” or “MPT”) (NYSE: MPT) today announced it will host a conference call and webcast on Monday, August 10, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time to discuss the Company’s second quarter 2026 financial results. A press release with the second quarter 2026 financial results will be issued before the market opens on August 10, 2026.
